name: Lyria 3.5
description: Lyria 3.5 is Google's music generation model with improved musicality, lyrics, vocal quality, and support for variable-length tracks up to three minutes.

details.name: availability_note
details.value: Available in Google Flow Music. Google has not published a Gemini API or Vertex AI model identifier for Lyria 3.5.

details.name: capability_note
details.value: Google describes improved vocals, musicality, lyrics, and variable song lengths.

page_notice.markdown: Lyria 3.5 is currently available in Google Flow Music, but Google has not yet documented a public API model identifier. Phaseo routing will remain disabled until an official endpoint is available.

sources.notes: Official product page describing Lyria 3.5 capabilities and Flow Music availability.
Official Google DeepMind model card supplied with the release.
The public API documentation currently lists only lyria-3-clip-preview and lyria-3-pro-preview.

verification.notes: Model identity and capabilities verified against Google DeepMind. Google's current Gemini API music guide still documents only the Lyria 3 Clip and Pro preview identifiers, so no public Lyria 3.5 API route is available.
